parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>

parameters.description_en:
The project ID.
1. You can log on to the [Internet of Things development console](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). After selecting the corresponding instance in the upper-left corner of the page, click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click the project card, and view the project ID in the address bar.
parameters.description_zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
